rows.whatWasWrong: The packet wrote eight participant-identity values onto 600-00228, the fee-waiver application -- docket number, case name, name, street address, city/state/zip, email and home/cell phone on page 1, and the participant's name on page 2 at field 117, the Printed Name line of Section 5 beneath 'I declare that the above statement is true and accurate ... I will be subject to the penalty of perjury' -- on a form the same packet's participant-instructions.md and its own bound instruction pages twice told the reader not to complete or file. The same map refused the other 66 fields of that form for the recorded reason 'no filing fee is charged on this track, so the fee-waiver branch is not applicable and this participant-supplied field is never populated with participant data on this route'. A packet may not fill a form in and tell the reader not to fill it in.
rows.whichHalfWasFalse: The controlling record settles it and no legal input was needed. legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json, packetSets[vt_exp_decriminalized-set], component vt_exp_decriminalized-fee-waiver-application-3, carries requirement 'conditional' with conditionDescription 'Only where a fee is charged; on this track none is.' The held fee answer for this route is that no fee is charged (32 V.S.A. Sec. 1431(e)'s $90 reaches only sealing a conviction under 23 V.S.A. Sec. 1201(a)). The condition is not met, the form is not filed, and the instruction page was right: the prefills were the false half. The docket number on a perjury declaration's Printed Name line was wrong under either reading and is gone under this one.
rows.howItWasRepaired: In this family's own builder only. The eight 600-00228 entries in POLICY_600_00228 moved from WRITE to a new NOT_FILED policy, which the existing feeWaiverNotApplicable branch already routes into a recorded refusal carrying that same reason, requiredBeforeFiling false. The form is still DELIVERED, exactly as the Judiciary publishes it, because the manifest carries it as a component of the set -- the treatment the sibling vt_seal_nonconviction-set already records for the identical form on the identical no-fee reasoning, whose FEE_WAIVER_COMPONENT_REQUIREMENT shape (nothingIsWrittenOnIt: true, deliveryTreatment 'delivered_unfilled') is now recorded here too, in production-field-map.json and reports/rendered-artifacts.json. A build-time assertion reads the OUTPUT BYTES and refuses the build if 600-00228 carries any drawn value in either fixture; the map was honest before this repair while the artifact still carried the eight values, so the map is not the place to check.
rows.noSharedModuleChanged: No shared module was touched. The change is confined to scripts/build-census-v1-vt_exp_decriminalized-set.mjs, which builds this family alone.
rows.instructionProseUnchanged: participant-instructions.md and the composed instruction pages are byte-identical to the committed ones: they already said, once and consistently, that no fee is charged on this track and that 600-00228 is not to be completed or filed. Nothing was added to paper over the contradiction; the write was removed instead.

rows.whatWasWrong: Coverage was already complete -- 112 map items against 112 instruction rows, matching one for one in both directions -- and every one of the 112 disclosureLabel values was the printed caption WITH THE ACROFORM FIELD NAME APPENDED, while the participant page twice described that column as the words the form prints beside the blank. The appended numbers correspond to nothing printed: 200-00130's question-1 charge table prints rows 1., 2. and 3., and the labels read 'Description of Offense 1', '... 4' and '... 7', so a participant matching by number fills the wrong line. 200-00130 fields 26, 27, 30 and 31 each carry two widgets in two unrelated tables -- the question-3 new-charge table on page 1 and the question-5 state-agency table on page 2 -- so one identifier named two different blanks.
rows.howItWasRepaired: The label is now the printed caption alone -- the shape the two sibling Vermont hosts already emit, vt_exp_decriminalized-set and vt_seal_nonconviction-set -- plus, ONLY where the same printed words appear beside more than one blank on one page, a locator resolved from the source page's own geometry. Where the form prints a row number beside every one of those blanks (found by looking for a line whose whole text is 'N.' at that blank's own height and to its LEFT), the printed number is used and the label says so: 'Description of Offense — row 1 as printed on the form'. Where it prints none, the locator is the blank's position down the page: '— first row (the form prints no row numbers here)'. Never the AcroForm index. Every finished label is asserted UNIQUE within its form and page, so two blanks can no longer share an identifier. The two sentences describing the column now say what the column is. The items are also emitted in reading order -- page, then down the page, then across the row -- because the committed list came out in field-tree order with page-2 blanks between page-1 blanks.
rows.whyTheBareSiblingShapeWasNotEnough: The sibling hosts emit the caption with no locator at all, which leaves three consecutive rows all reading 'Description of Offense' with only the what-to-write column to tell them apart. The brief's requirement -- disambiguate by something the participant can see on the page -- is met by the printed row number where the form prints one and by position where it does not, and the sibling's bare shape is what the label falls back to when the caption is unique.
rows.alsoRepairedInThisFamily: The captions themselves, on 600-00228. Removing the appended field name is not a repair if the caption underneath names a different blank, so every 600-00228 caption was re-derived from the pinned bytes by matching each widget's rectangle against the printed '$______' run whose baseline falls inside it -- the form's own marker for that row's blank -- and confirmed on a 200 dpi render of the source with every widget rectangle drawn and labelled. The page-1 expenses column was disclosed ONE ROW OFF from field 50 down: the blank beside the printed word Clothing was named 'the unlabelled expense line printed left of Clothing', the blank beside Medical was named Clothing, Child Support was named Medical, Auto Loan Payment was named Child Support, Property Taxes was named Auto Loan Payment, Insurance was named Property Taxes, Other Expenses was named Insurance, and the blank beside TOTAL EXPENSES was named Other Expenses. Eight blanks on a financial affidavit signed under penalty of perjury, each named after its neighbour. Field 35 was named 'Self-Employment/Business Income' and is the blank on the italic line under Other Income, 24 points above it. The Vehicles heading extracts interleaved and had been split as 'Make, Model' and 'Year / Fair Market Value'; read by x-position the printed columns are 'Make, Model, Year' and 'Fair Market Value (FMV)'. Seventeen captions corrected, each with its what-to-write, and each corrected caption is now asserted against the pinned bytes to be printed inside its own widget's rectangle -- a check the captionAt test cannot make, because a caption is still printed at its neighbour's coordinates.
rows.whatWasDeliberatelyNotMoved: 600-00228 fields MonthlyTotal and 41. The bottom of the page-1 income column is typographically broken in the source: four label lines and two printed '$______' runs, each run sitting 5.4 and 5.3 points below the label above it and 6.6 and 6.8 above the label below, so neither pairing is decided by the page. Nearest-baseline and the widget's own name 'MonthlyTotal' both agree with what the dictionary already records, so both are left exactly as committed and named here instead. 'Total Income in the past 12 months' may have no blank at all on this form.
rows.sharedHostScoping: The change is inside scripts/build-census-v1-vt_seal_misdemeanor-set.mjs, which is the shared host for five families, and it is SCOPED BY FAMILY ID to the three this lane holds, exactly as the committed PRESERVE_SOURCE_SELECTION_PAINT set in the same file is. vt_seal_dui-set and vt_seal_misdemeanor-set are not this lane's: their labels, their captions and their bytes are unchanged, and neither was claimed, built or read. Both still carry the appended field name and the shifted 600-00228 captions, and whoever holds them adds the id to PRINTED_CAPTION_DISCLOSURE_LABELS.
